text: I denied him not: Heb. I kept not back from him
follow me: Heb. are at my feet
message: Heb. word | pavillions: Or, Tents | set yourselves in aray: Or, place the engins, and they placed engins
young men: Or, servants | order: Heb. bind, or, tie
that thou hast lost: Heb. that was fallen
to fight against Israel: Heb. to the war with Israel
were all present: Or, were victualled
into an inner chamber: Or, from chamber to chamber. Heb. into a chamber within a chamber
smiting he wounded him: Heb. smiting and wounding
he was gone: Heb. he was not
